doc_metadata.notes: Response form template for proponents bidding on facilitation services. Specifies rated evaluation criteria and submission requirements for corporate profile, key personnel, facilitation methodology, value-added services, and relevant experience.
doc_metadata.title: APPENDIX D3 - RATED CRITERIA RESPONSE FORM – Facilitation

evaluation_criteria.notes: Evaluation of organization description, purpose, structure, employee count, products and services offered, experience range and depth, core expertise areas, and scope limitations.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to describe their organisation, its purpose, structure and makeup. Responses should include: Profile and history of the organisation; Number of employees; A list and description of the products and services you offer in support of the objectives and scope described in this service category, the range and depth of your experience with each, and identify which are your core areas of expertise or specialty; A list of any of our requirements that fall outside your firm's scope.

evaluation_criteria.title: Value-added

evaluation_criteria.notes: Evaluation of experience facilitating strategic planning sessions, retreats, workshops, team effectiveness initiatives, consultations, and stakeholder engagement activities. requirements.description: Key Personnel and Roster: Proponents are to demonstrate capabilities and capacity by describing their team, including brief profiles (maximum half page each) for up to 4 key individuals in dedicated relationship or coordination roles, with name, proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials.

source_refs.excerpt: A brief profile (no more than half a page) for each individual (maximum of 4) who would serve in a dedicated relationship or coordination role with the Bank — for example, a consultant, facilitator or project manager. These are the people we expect to interact with consistently, independent of any specific engagement. The profile should include: name and proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials.
source_refs.source_doc: OriginalRevision/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D3 - Rated Criteria Response Form.docx

requirements.description: Key Personnel and Roster: Proponents are to describe the practitioner talent available internally or externally, including range of expertise, vetting and development processes, quality and consistency standards for associates or contractors, and typical resource assignment process.

source_refs.excerpt: Describe the practitioner talent your firm can draw on, internally or externally. Rather than listing names or submitting bios for all potential resources, tell us about your bench/roster: the range of expertise available, how practitioners are vetted and developed, how you ensure quality and consistency when engaging associates or contractors, and what a typical resource assignment process looks like.
source_refs.source_doc: OriginalRevision/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D3 - Rated Criteria Response Form.docx

requirements.description: Facilitation Methodology: Proponents are to describe their facilitation methodology and approach for designing and delivering effective workshops and group engagements, including approach to understanding client objectives and participant needs, workshop design and session planning methodology, facilitation techniques for participation and collaboration, methods for managing differing viewpoints and conflict, and description of foundational models and frameworks.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to describe their facilitation methodology and approach for designing and delivering effective workshops and group engagements. The response should include: Approach to understanding client objectives and participant needs; Workshop design and session planning methodology; Facilitation techniques used to encourage participation and collaboration; Methods used to manage differing viewpoints, sensitive discussions, and conflict; A description of any models and frameworks that are foundational to your organization's products, approach and services
source_refs.source_doc: OriginalRevision/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D3 - Rated Criteria Response Form.docx
